title: LLaVA-OneVision: Single-Image, Multi-Image, Video in One Model

questions.question: What does anyres_tokens(tiles=9, per_tile=182) return for the single-image plan?
options: 1,820, counting nine tiles plus one global thumbnail
1,638, counting only the nine tiles
182, because all tiles are pooled into one token
2,916, because each tile uses the unpooled 729-token grid
questions.explanation: anyres_tokens computes (tiles + 1) * per_tile. Thus (9+1)*182 = 1,820 visual tokens including the thumbnail.

questions.question: What does per_tile_tokens(384, 14, 2) return?
options: 729, because 384/14 is rounded to 27 and no pooling occurs
169, because floor(384/14)=27, pooled by 2 to 13, then squared
192, because pooling halves only one spatial axis
576, because 384px always means the base LLaVA count
questions.explanation: The helper uses g=384//14=27, pooled=g//2=13, and returns 13*13=169 tokens for one tile.

questions.question: Which plan does plan_video(4096) choose first?
options: 8 frames at 336 with pool 2, because it always minimizes tokens
16 frames at 384 with pool 2, totaling 2,704 tokens
32 frames at 384 with pool 3, totaling 2,592 tokens
32 frames at 384 with no pooling, totaling 23,328 tokens
questions.explanation: The first fitting loop choice is 32 frames, 384 resolution, pool 3. Each frame has 9*9=81 tokens, so the total is 32*81=2,592.

questions.question: What is the intended order of curriculum_stages before the target-task mix?
options: Video first, then single-image, then multi-image specialists
Multi-image only, then freeze the model before video
Randomly interleave all scenarios from the first optimizer step
Single-image (SI), then OneVision mixed training (OV), then target-task fine-tuning (TT)
questions.explanation: curriculum_stages prints SI with single-image data, OV with a 0.5/0.3/0.2 mixture, and TT using the requested final mix. The order is part of the transfer recipe.

questions.question: What does plan_multi_image(4096) select before trying smaller image counts?
options: Eight 384px images with pool 2, for 8*169 = 1,352 tokens
Six 384px images without pooling, for 6*729 = 4,374 tokens
Four 336px images with pool 1, for 4*576 = 2,304 tokens
Two 384px images with pool 2, because the loop starts at two
questions.explanation: The loop tries n_images in [8,6,4,2] and first tests 384/pool2. Each image has 169 tokens, so eight images use 1,352 and fit the 4,096 budget.

questions.question: Which capability does the demo label as an emergent result of the combined curriculum?
options: A larger text-only vocabulary
An iPhone-screenshot agent, alongside multi-camera reasoning and set-of-mark prompting
Automatic audio diarization without an audio encoder
A replacement for all visual-token pooling
questions.explanation: The driver names multi-camera reasoning, set-of-mark prompting, and the iPhone-screenshot agent as capabilities that do not appear in the single-image-only stage.
